name: NotificationStack
description: A toast stack where each trigger press springs in a new notification that reflows the list via layout animation, auto-dismisses after a timeout and slides out on dismiss.
a11yNotes: Toasts render in a <ul> with aria-live="polite" so new messages are announced. Every toast has a labelled dismiss <button type="button">, the trigger is a native button with a visible focus ring, and all auto-dismiss timers are cleared on unmount. Under prefers-reduced-motion toasts only fade, with no layout, slide or scale motion.

propsApi.name: messages
propsApi.default: ['Build succeeded', 'New comment on your PR', 'Deployed to production', '3 new stars']
propsApi.description: Messages cycled through on each trigger press.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds; 0 disables auto-dismiss.

propsApi.name: maxVisible
propsApi.description: Maximum number of toasts visible at once; oldest are dropped.

propsApi.name: position
propsApi.description: Whether new toasts appear at the top or bottom of the stack.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
